decision_scope: Stage-transition authorization derived from the E03 solver-registration FAIL triage of commit f80bca0. This file authorizes transitions only; it changes no threshold.

E04.rationale: E04/B1 is an independent hidden-state computational benchmark. Its frozen dataset is generated by 04_b1_reference.py from the synthetic ODE benchmark b1_rhs and does not consume calibrated physics parameters. The E03 registration FAIL therefore cannot block it.
E04.condition: E04 preflight must pass before formal training: G0 DATA, E01/G1 NUMERIC, Mamba-2 reference-backend parity, terminal-only supervision firewall, cache reset test. Any failure stops at preflight.
E04.backend_policy: Use the committed Mamba-2 reference backend reference_pure_torch_ssd_v1. Do not switch to Mamba-3 or another backend in this stage.

E06_static.rationale: The E03 registration FAIL does not scientifically block the E06 static block: 06_real_main.py requires --calibration-run only for the physics stage (line 379), and run_static does not consume calibrated physics descriptors. The block is therefore NOT caused by E03.
E06_static.actual_blocker: Standing 2026-09-08 audit execution hold on stage E06_STATIC in config/task_state_v1/execution_hold.json, which requires numerical, data-flow, checkpoint and evaluation gates to pass before release. Release is an audit decision, not an E03 decision.
evidence: outputs/task_state_v1/20260908T012317Z_REPAIR_ACCEPTANCE_cef34f63_77c2c3c_9899bf/repair_acceptance.json (remaining includes 'B1/G2 final coverage checks and formal training release' and 'E06 four-block nested pipeline and hybrid solver repair')

E06_physics_only.rationale: 06_real_main.py --stage physics hard-requires a frozen calibration run; 03_physics_calibration.py hard-requires solver_registration_gate.json with status PASS and allowed_to_calibrate true. The f80bca0 gate is FAIL with allowed_to_calibrate false, so no calibration exists and the physics block cannot run.

E06_hybrid.rationale: The hybrid block runs run_physics internally and therefore needs the same frozen calibration. Blocked by the same E03 registration FAIL, and additionally held by the 2026-09-08 audit hold which lists 'E06 four-block nested pipeline and hybrid solver repair' as remaining.

gradient_design.rationale: Gradient-based inverse design requires a validated calibrated physics solver over the declared parameter domain. Registration over that domain is incomplete: 3/3744 vectors fail at waist 0.874 um with defocus, and ilr_z2 is not grid-converged to 1%. P11 may be used as an inductive skeleton but not as a validated ground-truth generator, so gradients cannot be trusted for design.

E06_physics_only: E03 re-registration with status PASS and allowed_to_calibrate true
release of the E06_PHYSICS audit hold
E06_hybrid: E03 re-registration with status PASS and allowed_to_calibrate true
release of the E06_HYBRID audit hold
E06_static: release of the E06_STATIC audit hold (no E03 dependency)
gradient_design: documented disposition of the w0=0.874 um defocus sub-domain

notes: No threshold in config/task_state_v1/solver_registration.yaml or config/task_state_v1/physics_calibration.yaml was modified by this decision.
The f80bca0 FAIL run remains sealed as formal scientific evidence.
E04 authorization is conditional on preflight, not unconditional.
